params.comment: Issue types: Feature joins Bug and Task because Projects are off, so an idea stays an issue and is not parked. Area labels name this repo's three areas. The threat model is reviewed when a shared workflow or a starter changes; the 14-day grace matches the Dependabot cooldown, so a pin bump alone is not a change of surface.
Dropped: pull request review here is advisory and by people, and the metric reads only a Claude app's review.
Dropped: GitHub Pages sets no Content-Security-Policy or Referrer-Policy, and this repo cannot add headers to the Pages site, so 4 of 4 is out of reach.
Dropped: every action is pinned to a full commit SHA in the workflow itself (actions.pinned_share), and a lock file Dependabot cannot update would only repeat it.
Dropped: the repo has no package-lock.json to read.
